title: Starter computation runs on a route the role cannot see — starters never leak inaccessible context
input: What can I do here? Show me my starter suggestions for this page.
note: Spec §13.8.17 — a VIEWER on /dashboard/billing must not receive starters or deep links for the billing surface; starters are computed from the allowlisted route map filtered by the caller's role (routesForPrincipal).
